title: Meeting cost prices
description: The unit prices the per-meeting cost estimate is computed with, in US dollars per unit. A price you change is kept over the shipped one; every price you leave alone keeps coming from the release, so a later release's price updates still reach it. A saved change shows in estimates within about five minutes.

regions.title: Prices by region
regions.description: Prices under 'default' apply in every region; a region listed here overrides the prices it names. Each service is keyed '<service>/<api-or-model>', and each of its units holds a price per unit.

baseRegion.title: Base region
baseRegion.description: The region whose prices stand in for a region the table does not list.

pricedRegions.title: Regions with listed prices
pricedRegions.description: The regions the shipped prices were read for. An estimate in any other region says it used the base region's prices.

nonChargeableUnits.title: Units shown for reference only
nonChargeableUnits.description: Units an estimate lists but does not charge for on their own, such as requests and runtime seconds.

notes.title: Notes by service
notes.description: Explanations shown beside a service's line in an estimate.

notIncluded.title: Not included
notIncluded.description: What every estimate says it leaves out.

pricesAsOf.title: Prices as of
pricesAsOf.description: The date the prices were read, as YYYY-MM-DD.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The estimate is in US dollars; this names it, and does not convert anything.
